ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 22
   D. 15

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 60
   C. 19
   D. 30

5. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 40.5
   C. 10
   D. 81

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

12. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
